_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Restart the server after editing (scripts/stop.sh && scripts/start.sh). Keys starting with _ are ignored.

weather._comment: Set latitude and longitude (decimal degrees) to enable weather, e.g. 37.7749, -122.4194 with label "San Francisco".

assistant._comment: Standalone questions via Vercel AI Gateway. The API key is NOT stored here: see README (scripts/set-assistant-key.sh). allowed_hosts: hostnames (besides IPs and localhost) the dashboard is reached by.

maps._comment: Weather map slideshow (Maps tab + small card on the Weather tab). See README. Key is in .env.

calendar._comment: Google Calendar (read-only). Sign in once with: python3 gcal.py auth. Client ID/secret are in .env, the sign-in token in data/gcal-token.json. See README.

health._comment: Built-in health checks shown on the admin page (https://<server>:8443/admin). targets: other services on your network, {"name","type":"tcp","host","port"} or {"name","type":"http","url"}. Set google_token_max_age_days to null once your Google Cloud app is published.

kuma._comment: Optional Uptime Kuma: set base_url and status_page_slug (or use_metrics with KUMA_API in .env), then enabled.

local_ai._comment: Optional local fallback models (llama.cpp / whisper.cpp) in a local-ai/ folder next to this project. See README "Local fallback". Editable from the admin page.

home._comment: Home tab (optional). kind 'ha' calls a Home Assistant service; the token is HA_TOKEN in .env (admin page -> API keys). Entity ids: HA -> Settings -> Entities. kind 'media_switch' (advanced, optional) swaps Plex/Jellyfin through your own root-owned /usr/local/sbin/media-switch and a sudoers rule; see README.

cameras._comment: Cameras tab (optional, up to 6). type 'ha' (default): a Home Assistant camera (e.g. Blink: snapshots); popup jumps to it when its motion sensor turns on; blink_live (the camera's name in a Blink live-view proxy) adds an on-demand live view through that proxy at blink_proxy_url (token: BLINK_PROXY_TOKEN in .env); without a proxy, set blink_proxy_url to "" and drop blink_live. type 'rtsp': a local camera with live view (e.g. V380 with ONVIF turned on in its app); ffmpeg turns the stream into MJPEG only while someone watches. rtsp_url is the sub-stream (SD), rtsp_url_hd the main stream; onvif_url adds pan/tilt and day/night; mac lets the server find the camera again if its address changes. No user:password in URLs.

database._comment: Optional history in a local PostgreSQL through the psql client (peer login, no password; setup in pgstore.py). Off by default.

tts._comment: Spoken Ask answers. 'piper' = local Piper voices (scripts/install-piper.sh); 'google' = Google Cloud TTS with a service-account key, Piper as the fallback.
